what: Legacy UE build: a licensed hero corgi mesh blocked character work for days and ended on a German Shepherd stand-in
evidence: docs/legacy/README_unreal.md CHAR-01A-BASE/DISK entries
rule: Characters are code-generated first; AI meshes only for statues/props after a license check

what: Legacy UE build: a pending human verdict (FEEL-06) blocked unrelated work (OBJ-05 HUD) for weeks
evidence: docs/legacy/README_unreal.md frontier
rule: Human play sessions are milestone events, never locks on other work

what: Legacy UE build: proof ceremony (hash receipts, RED reviews, OPS attestor chain) outgrew gameplay progress
evidence: docs/legacy/ROADMAP_unreal_v1.4.md OPS-13..26
rule: One gate command + screenshots + one commit per task

what: Legacy UE build was never committed (main unborn, 0 tracked files)
evidence: docs/legacy/README_unreal.md OPS-08A
rule: Commit and push at the end of every task

what: three Raycaster over stylized scenes crashes on LineSegments2 crease ink (needs raycaster.camera)
evidence: tools/probe.mjs pageerror in third-person.ts
rule: Camera/gameplay raycasts use flattened solid-mesh lists that skip userData.styleInk and isLineSegments2

what: Headless Chromium (SwiftShader, WebGL2 fallback) renders the toon pipeline at ~7 fps at 1280x720
evidence: __cvc.fps in tools/probe.mjs run
rule: Judge looks from screenshots in CI; judge fps only on real GPUs

what: Rapier 0.21 scene queries (castRay, intersectionWithShape) go through the broad-phase BVH, which only world.step() refreshes: colliders are invisible before the first step, and a collider moved with setTranslation is still found at its old place until the next step
evidence: scratch probe: castRay down onto a crate returned no hit before sim.step() and toi 3 after; shape query false before / true after
rule: Never move colliders to rewind for lag compensation; test rewound characters analytically (ray vs capsule, src/sim/combat/geometry.ts). Build anything query-based (nav grid) after the first physics step.

what: Straight-down Rapier rays slip through the West Yard heightfield along grid lines
evidence: 23% of vertical rays on a 0.5 m lattice missed (30235/130321), 0.45% of random vertical rays, 0% of slanted rays; a test spawn at (12,0) got y=-110 and was teleported by the out-of-bounds guard; a mortar dropped straight down fell through the terrain
rule: Probe ground with WorldData.height(), not vertical raycasts; projectiles keep a height() backstop (projectiles.ts terrainHit).

what: Character controller cost on the West Yard heightfield is ~8x the flat slab: movement for 8 characters p50 1.25 ms vs 0.15 ms flat; terrain-only 1.0 ms vs props-only 0.3 ms
evidence: scratch kcc bench (8 chars, same process, same load, CPU time per step); soak breakdown: movement 1.1-2.2 ms/tick vs all L3 systems 0.15-0.36 ms/tick
rule: Budget ~0.13 ms per character per tick for movement on the heightfield; the 3 ms tick budget (12 players + 16 bots) needs a cheaper terrain collider (coarser/chunked heightfield, check FIX_INTERNAL_EDGES) before Wave 2.

what: Nav grid from the real colliders stays cheap if only cells near prop AABBs get a Rapier capsule probe (with the heightfield collider excluded) and terrain is judged from neighbour height() gradients; bounding-circle AABBs of long rotated fences covered the whole yard, exact rotated AABBs fixed it
evidence: West Yard 200x200: 3959 probes instead of 39203 with 0 differing cells; build ~40 ms warm / ~110 ms cold; full probes ~145 ms
rule: Prefilter spatial probes with exact rotated AABBs, exclude the terrain collider from prop probes, and fall back to probing every cell when the world holds colliders the prefilter doesn't know about.

what: On a shared 4-core box (load 7-17 from parallel lanes' headless Chromium) wall-clock tick p95 inflated 2-4x; process.cpuUsage also counts V8 GC/JIT threads (cpu p95 5.9 ms while wall p95 2.1 ms); process.threadCpuUsage is too coarse per tick
evidence: tools/soak.mjs: identical deterministic runs read single-run tick p95 1.7-6 ms depending on load (p50 steady 1.0-1.4 ms); best-of-3 per tick stayed 1.4-1.6 ms at load 6-10
rule: Gate per-tick cost on min(wall, process CPU), take the per-tick minimum across N deterministic repeats (and assert the repeats' outcomes are identical), and record machine load with the result.

what: Over-the-shoulder aiming: the camera ray is parallel to the eye ray but ~0.55 m right and 0.2 m up, so eye-ray hitscan misses a 0.36 m-radius target the crosshair is on
evidence: third-person camera: pivot +1.25 m, shoulder 0.55/0.75 m; test 'a human shot lands where the over-the-shoulder crosshair points' (combat.test.ts)
rule: For camera-aimed players trace the crosshair ray (AIM_RAY constants in weapons.ts) to find the aim point, then fire from the eye toward it; keep the camera numbers and AIM_RAY in sync.

what: Decrementing a weapon cooldown below zero before the first shot and then adding the interval gave a one-tick credit: 11 shots per second from a 10 rps rifle
evidence: combat.test.ts 'auto fire runs at exactly the fire rate' failed with 11 vs 10 until the decrement only ran while cooldown > 0
rule: Only count cooldowns down while positive; keep the sub-tick negative carry after a shot so fractional fire rates stay exact.

what: Bot class balance in the open West Yard (mirrored 4v4, 4x3 min): species even (corgis 116-120 vs cats 120-125 kills) but Warden shotgun bots k/d 0.1-0.4 vs Overwatch 1.4-2.0 and Breacher ~1.4
evidence: scratch balance runs; warden bots died at ~27 m average killer distance before closing to shotgun range
rule: Close-range bot kits need a cover-hopping approach before they are shipped as team fill; tune kits with mirrored lineups.

what: Unit tests that hard-code world coordinates broke when the world lane replaced createWorldData with West Yard (sim-movement: the origin is now a trampoline and the crate ring is gone)
evidence: 5 sim-movement tests fail identically with and without combat/AI/match systems; L3 tests that locate lanes/obstacles at runtime kept passing
rule: Tests either pin createFlatWorldData() or discover positions at runtime (nav grid lanes, obstacle crossings) — never assume the default world's layout.

what: Instanced TSL particles in 'stretched' and 'ground' modes rendered nothing: the custom quad mapping (perp=(-along.y,along.x); ground +y→+z) mirrored the winding and FrontSide culling dropped every quad
evidence: artifacts/l5-dbg.png beam experiments; fix in src/client/fx/particle-mesh.ts (perp=(along.y,-along.x), ground +y→-z)
rule: When a vertexNode builds quads from basis vectors, keep det(right, up) > 0 (or the material side) — test each placement mode on screen

what: three r186 TSL throws "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'addToStack')" at VarNode.build when cameraViewMatrix/cameraProjectionMatrix (shared Fn().once() nodes) are first referenced inside select()/If branches of a vertexNode or inside If/Discard in a nested Fn
evidence: console error in labs/juice.html first run; resolved in src/client/fx/particle-mesh.ts
rule: In vertexNode/colorNode graphs use arithmetic blends (step/mix weights) instead of select over camera-matrix expressions, and material.maskNode instead of If(...Discard)

what: FX meshes hidden until their first particle compile their pipeline on the first shot of a match (a visible stall); keeping them visible with instanceCount 0 builds the pipeline at load and issues no draw (RenderObject.getDrawParameters returns null)
evidence: src/client/fx/particle-mesh.ts, onomatopoeia-view.ts; three/src/renderers/common/RenderObject.js getDrawParameters
rule: Pre-warm pooled FX by leaving the instanced mesh visible at count 0

what: A CSS keyframe animation on opacity overrides the element's inline style.opacity, so the low-HP vignette pulsed permanently and washed out the kill feed
evidence: artifacts/l5-combat.png iteration 1 vs 2; fix in src/client/ui/hud-style.ts (.vig-low::after)
rule: Animate a child/pseudo-element and drive the parent's opacity from JS (or vice versa) — never both on one element

what: Headless Chromium here cannot load Google Fonts (net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID behind the agent proxy) and tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts fails on any console error
evidence: playwright font test in L5 session; src/client/ui/fonts.ts
rule: Self-host OFL fonts (license file alongside) instead of runtime Google Fonts links

what: With 5 lanes running headless SwiftShader browsers the 4-core box sat at load average 15-20; lab frames took 1-8 s, rAF stalled while JS stayed responsive, and fixed-wait probes captured blank pre-first-frame pages
evidence: uptime + __juice.frames polling in L5 session
rule: Labs trigger scripted moments by frame count, not wall clock, and captures wait for a readiness flag; judge fps only on real GPUs

what: Heap-based zero-allocation tests (v8 --expose_gc via vm) need a long warm-up: TurboFan code objects inflated the first 5k calls by ~45 KB while 20k later calls grew < 10 KB
evidence: tests/unit/fx-particles.test.ts; per-recipe scan in L5 session
rule: Warm up thousands of iterations, then assert heap growth far below 1 byte per operation

what: The local death event (bus, immediate) and the Dead flag (interpolated state, ~100 ms later) arrive in either order; a freshness window keyed to 'now' flipped the killer to 'the yard itself' after 4 s on the death screen
evidence: artifacts/l5-dead.png iterations; fix in src/client/ui/hud.ts (deathBy map matched against deathAt)
rule: Match event records to state transitions by record time relative to the transition, never relative to the current time

what: three r186 TSL: vec3(new THREE.Color(hex)) evaluates to black, so style-webgpu glow() (colorNode = vec3(Color).mul(k)) renders every glow part black; uniform(new THREE.Color(hex)).mul(k) and vec3(r,g,b).mul(k) render correctly
evidence: labs/characters.html lens swap on the same mesh+pipeline: vec3(Color)=rgb(0,0,0), uniform(Color)=rgb(255,138,97), vec3(1,.2,.2)=rgb(255,200,172); artifacts/l1-glowbug-vec3color-black.png vs l1-glowbug-uniform-ok.png
rule: Build TSL colors with uniform(Color) or color(hex), never vec3(Color); verify any new glow in a screenshot, not just that it compiles

what: toonOutlinePass outlines THREE.SkinnedMesh correctly in r186: NodeMaterial.setupVertex runs skinning into positionLocal/normalLocal before the outline material's vertexNode reads them, so one merged skinned toon mesh (vertex colors) gets a continuous ink hull with no custom inverted-hull child
evidence: node_modules/three/src/materials/nodes/NodeMaterial.js setupVertex/setupPosition order; artifacts/l1-lab-*.png show continuous ink on 45-bone skinned characters in all poses (zoomies, death flop)
rule: Skinned characters: merge fur+face+gear into one SkinnedMesh with vertex colors and per-part smoothNormalsByPosition; keep crease ink on rigid props only

what: Two three.js math gotchas in procedural rigs: (1) q.slerpQuaternions(qa, q, t) aliases its output with the qb input and returns qa (the weapon stayed frozen in low-ready while aiming); (2) writing bone.quaternion triggers the Euler-sync onChange callback, costing ~6 us per 45-bone avatar per frame
evidence: tests/unit/characters.test.ts 'weapon points where the player aims' (angle < 0.05 rad) caught (1); timing harness: RigInstance.apply 8.6 -> 2.7 us/avatar after writing bone.matrix with matrixAutoUpdate=false (24 avatars: 0.75 ms/frame total)
rule: Never pass the target as an input to Quaternion.slerpQuaternions/Vector lerps; for code-driven rigs compute local matrices yourself and write Bone.matrix with matrixAutoUpdate=false

what: Clearing isMeshToonNodeMaterial does NOT opt a MeshToonNodeMaterial out of toonOutlinePass: the node material inherits isMeshToonMaterial=true via setDefaultValues(new MeshToonMaterial()) and the pass tests `isMeshToonMaterial || isMeshToonNodeMaterial`
evidence: West Yard foliage kept a black copy per tuft; with the ink uniform set to red the copy turned red; in-page check showed isMeshToonNodeMaterial=false on the material; clearing both flags removed it (labs/world.html close-up before/after)
rule: Ink opt-out for toon-lit materials = clear BOTH isMeshToonNodeMaterial and isMeshToonMaterial on your own instance (src/client/world/materials.ts toonNoInk); never on a toon() cache entry

what: toonOutlinePass's outline material ignores the source material's positionNode, so an inked mesh with vertex wind/sway gets a static ink copy at the undisplaced position (reads as black blades/leaves)
evidence: positionNode = positionLocal + (0.3,0,0) on grass tufts: green tuft moved 0.3 m, a black ink-colored tuft stayed at the original spot
rule: Anything animated in the vertex stage (wind, bob) must be ink-free (toonNoInk) or get its own outline

what: Same West Yard grid triangles as a Rapier trimesh instead of a heightfield: straight-down ray misses 0% vs 24.5% on a 0.5 m lattice (0.005% vs 0% random), KCC 0.77 vs 2.42 ms/tick for 8 runners; no character fall-through on grid vertices in either
evidence: npx tsx tools/world-physics-bench.mjs (Rapier 0.21 compat, 241x241 grid, FIX_INTERNAL_EDGES on both); tests/unit/world.test.ts lattice test: 0/158k misses on the trimesh
rule: Terrain collider = TRIMESH of the render triangles (src/sim/world/build.ts); identify it with isTerrainCollider(), not ShapeType.HeightField

what: A hand-built 92-triangle bevel box (flat faces + 2-segment rounded edges/corners, analytic normals) gives the same toon + single-crease-line look as RoundedBoxGeometry(segments=2) at 300 triangles
evidence: West Yard merged props 276k -> 118k triangles with identical screenshots; unit check: closed (every edge shared twice), outward winding, 92 tris
rule: Use bevelBoxGeometry (src/client/world/prim-mesh.ts) for chunky props; 45-degree middle bevel break = exactly one crease at the 35-degree crease threshold

what: 3-band toon lighting turns gentle lawn undulation into dark camouflage blotches seen from above when flat ground sits near a band edge (edge at N.L=1/3, i.e. sun elevation 19.5 deg for flat ground)
evidence: overview at t=0.68 (sun ~30 deg): blotchy before; bending terrain shading normals 40% toward up (geometry untouched) removed them while the mound/pond banks still read
rule: Terrain toon: soften shading normals (normalNode = mix(normalView, up, 0.4)) and keep default sun elevation >= 10 deg away from a band edge

what: Headless screenshot runs die with 'Execution context was destroyed' when Vite full-reloads the page because another lane saved a file mid-run
evidence: tools/world-shots.mjs: 2 of ~40 probe runs hit it; the retry succeeded each time
rule: Wrap probe/screenshot batches in a retry that also rejects blank frames (contrast < 6), see tools/world-shots.mjs
